entities.summary: Paul Etoga was a Cameroonian Catholic prelate who served as the bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Mbalmayo, in Cameroon from 24 June 1961 until his age-related retirement on 7 March 1987. Before that, from 3 July 1955 until 24 June 1961, he served as auxiliary bishop of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Yaoundé, Cameroon. He was appointed bishop by Pope Pius XII and contemporanueously assigned as Titular Bishop of Cyparissia. He was consecrated on 30 November 1955 by René Marie Graffin, Archbishop of Yaoundé.
